_doc: Allowed levers for the nightly experiment loop (experiment_loop.py). ONLY these levers and values can ever be applied (main.apply_loop / arm_for). Order = test queue. pacing 'fast' and length 'short' were checked 2026-10-16 for seed acceptance (cup 1.25% / 4.3%, royale 20% / 19% of seeds - enough inside the director's 300-400 tries). Length is judged on views@72h: a shorter video gets a higher % watched for free.

levers.hypothesis: A 16-country royale heat gives a 91%-UK audience a stake (find your country), raising avg % watched over a 1-v-1 cup match.

variants: Pick a country before it starts!
levers.hypothesis: Asking viewers to commit to a country before the first ring breaks makes them stay to see it through, raising avg % watched.
A first ring inside ~1s and no lull over 4.5s (vs 2s / 6s) removes the early dead moments where viewers swipe.
Capping matches at 20s (royale 26s) gets more full watches and replays, which TikTok rewards with more views.
